lead: Each entry gets an icon, the size of the reduction and a line on how eligibility is proved. The proof is the part that stops the band from generating enquiries.
note: The note carries what applies across the programmes — whether they stack, what they apply to, and how long they last.

programmes.title: The size of the reduction is in the title
programmes.text: A reader scanning the grid should not have to open anything to learn what it is worth.

programmes.title: The proof is named
programmes.text: Which document, sent where — the sentence that answers the enquiry before it is written.

programmes.title: A card may be a link
programmes.text: Then the whole card becomes the target and the title carries the accessible name.

programmes.title: Two to four columns
programmes.text: The grid reflows on the room it has rather than on the width of the viewport.
